Your Role

As a Trading Analyst, you'll work alongside our traders on projects that directly support the investment process across global markets. You'll analyze trading activity, study market structure and liquidity, investigate how news and geopolitical events influence prices, and help improve how we execute systematic investment strategies.

This is a hands-on role where you'll learn by doing—working with experienced traders, portfolio managers, researchers, and technologists on real problems that matter every day.

You'll have opportunities to:

  • Analyze trading costs, market structure, and liquidity across asset classes.
  • Explore how macroeconomic events, earnings, policy decisions, and geopolitical developments impact markets.
  • Build analytical tools and perform research to improve execution and trading decisions.
  • Work with large datasets to identify patterns, test hypotheses, and generate actionable insights.
  • Collaborate closely with portfolio managers, researchers, and technologists on projects spanning the investment process.

What Makes a Great Trading Analyst

We're looking for intellectually curious, collaborative people who are passionate about financial markets and excited to learn.

Successful analysts typically:

  • Are fascinated by global markets and naturally follow financial, economic, and geopolitical developments.
  • Enjoy understanding why markets move and how news is reflected in prices, volatility, and liquidity.
  • Have a genuine interest in market structure, trading, and liquidity across multiple asset classes.
  • Are collaborative team players who communicate well, ask thoughtful questions, and enjoy learning from others.
  • Believe the best answers come from data. They enjoy testing hypotheses and using data science to solve real-world trading and investment problems. Whether through programming, AI-assisted tools, or other analytical approaches, they are motivated by finding evidence-based solutions rather than relying on intuition alone.
  • Take ownership, bring a positive attitude, and are eager to contribute to the success of the team.

This is a senior operating role for an entrepreneurial, technically fluent digital professional who can design and implement strategy across core MarTech platforms, partner with Technology on roadmaps and sprint planning, and bring the same rigor to vendor accountability that they bring to their own work.

Digital platform strategy and vendor management

  • Build and implement end-to-end strategy across the firm's core marketing technology platforms including contracting, renewals, SLAs, and performance accountability for every vendor in the stack.

VP - Capital Partnerships, Energy

Brookfield Energy operates one of the world’s largest publicly traded platforms for sustainable energy. Our energy portfolio consists of hydroelectric, wind, utility-scale solar, distributed generation and storage facilities in North America, South America, Europe and Asia. Our operating capacity totals over 35,000 megawatts and our development pipeline stands at approximately 200,000 megawatts. Our portfolio of sustainable solutions assets includes our investments in Westinghouse (a leading global nuclear services business) and a utility and independent power producer with operations in the Caribbean and Latin America, as well as both operating assets and a development pipeline of carbon capture and storage capacity, agricultural renewable natural gas and materials recycling.

Brookfield Energy is the flagship listed energy company of Brookfield Asset Management, a leading global alternative asset manager with over $1 trillion of assets under management.

To learn more about the Brookfield Energy group, visit https://www.brookfield.com/about-us/capabilities/energy

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role and Responsibilities

The VP will play a key role in supporting Brookfield’s leadership position in the energy transition by delivering innovative investment solutions that mobilize capital toward scalable energy and decarbonization opportunities. This role will work closely with the investment, sustainability, and asset management teams to design and structure investment vehicles and capital programs that will enable Brookfield to capture new investment opportunities and grow its Energy platform. The role will collaborate closely with Brookfield’s institutional investor base to build strategic investment partnerships, design capital solutions, and raise third-party equity across the platform.

Key responsibilities include:

Support new investment products

  • Facilitate the creation and structuring of new investment products within the Renewable Power and Transition franchise by aligning LP capital allocation considerations with key Energy investment themes;
  • Lead research of new sectors and conduct preliminary screening of opportunities that could form the foundation of future investment strategies

Design and execute capital solutions

  • Independently structure, execute, and negotiate equity capital solutions for existing and new fund investments, including co-investments, continuation vehicles, yield cos, club deals, joint ventures, minority stake sales and broader capital partnerships;
    • Work closely with the wider investment team to design funding strategy for larger transactions and identify institutional partners for engagement
    • Lead market sounding and investor outreach, working with advisors or Brookfield’s Global Client Group where applicable to identify and reach out to potential investment partners
    • Oversee junior team members on the preparation of investment memoranda, financial models, and due diligence materials to be shared with Brookfield’s investment partners
    • Leverage deep knowledge of the investment, including underwritten business plan, key diligence findings, risk / return profile, and value drivers to lead investor diligence, supporting their analysis and review of the transaction
    • Collaborate with legal counsel and senior team members to draft and negotiate key transaction terms and governance
    • Work collaboratively with tax and finance on investment structures
    • Balances investor requirements with transaction certainty and timing

Engage and partner with existing and potential institutional investors

  • Present Brookfield’s Energy investment strategy to prospective LPs, including communicating our overall investment approach, fund and investment performance, operating capabilities and Impact expertise; proactively identify LP prospects where applicable;
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Renewable Power and Impact investing, representing the Energy platform in investor meetings and at industry events to educate the market on our strategy;
  • Structure and formalize relationships with catalytic or concessionary capital providers where applicable;

Desired Qualifications

  • 8 – 10 years of experience in investment banking or direct investments or co-investment structuring/syndication;
  • Strong transactional experience in private markets;
  • Undergraduate degree in business or finance;
  • Analytical and strategic thinker with the ability to assess complex situations, analyze quantitative and qualitative information, and make effective recommendations;
  • Proactive self-starter who is able to handle pressure effectively;
  • Can lead projects independently with strong project management skills;
  • Able to effectively coach and manage junior team members and demonstrates a commitment to shared success;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a particular strength in liaising with cross-functional teams and senior investment decision makers;
  • Experience with renewables, power, energy or infrastructure an asset, but not required

Role: Investment Management Operations Manager

Level: Manager

Function: Funds & Operations

Reporting to: Head of Operations Japan

The Team

The Japan Investment Management Operations (IMOps) team supports PIMCO’s Tokkin and pension account structures within Japanese Trust Bank frameworks.The team serves as a key operational interface across Account Management, Portfolio Management / Trade Support, and global teams, while closely coordinating with trust banks, custodians, brokers, and external service providers.The team is responsible for maintaining operational stability, managing operational risk, supporting business growth initiatives, and facilitating regulatory and market practice changes.

The Role

The Japan IMOps Manager leads the Tokyo IMOps team and provides operational leadership across Japanese trust bank structures supporting Tokkin and pension account operations.The role provides operational leadership across trade lifecycle oversight, cash and collateral management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and strategic, regulatory and market practice initiatives.Acting as a key coordination point between Japan and global teams, the role ensures effective operational execution while balancing local market requirements with global standards and operating objectives.The position requires strong judgment, stakeholder management, and the ability to lead operational delivery within a complex and highly constrained environment.

Core responsibilities include:

Core Operational

  • Manage Japan IMOps operational activities across Japanese trust bank structures, including Tokkin and pension accounts
  • Manage trade lifecycle processes, settlement monitoring, cash and collateral management, and operational support functions
  • Maintain operational stability across complex local operational structures and external service provider models

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with Japanese trust banks, custodians, brokers, vendors, and internal PIMCO teams
  • Provide timely guidance and coordination on operational inquiries, issues and exceptions raised by internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a key liaison across Japan and global stakeholders to support operational execution and issue resolution
  • Act as a key operational point of coordination with Account Management, Portfolio Management / Trade Support, and the Cash Desk across client flows, operational events, market activities, and funding requirements

Strategic, Regulatory & Market Practice Initiatives

  • Lead and support implementation of new products, market expansion initiatives, and regulatory or market practice changes
  • Support onboarding of new accounts, new markets, new operational processes, and operational change initiatives
  • Ensure Japan market requirements are appropriately represented and incorporated into global initiatives and operating frameworks

Operational Risk Management & Control

  • Maintain robust operational controls and proactively identify operational risks
  • Coordinate issue resolution and remediation efforts across internal and external stakeholders
  • Provide operational support for audit, compliance, and regulatory inquiries and reviews

Team Management

  • Lead, coach and develop the Tokyo IMOps team while fostering accountability, collaboration and operational excellence
  • Ensure operational stability, accountability, appropriate coverage, and succession readiness
  • Support continuous process improvement and operational resiliency initiatives

Examples of Operational Coverage

  • Oversight of key vendor partners,(outsourced middle office), operational activities across Japan structures
  • Coordination and process alignment with Japanese trust banks, brokers, outsourced partners and internal PIMCO teams
  • Cash and collateral management oversight
  • Support for regulatory and market practice change preparation and implementation
  • New market onboarding and operational process implementation
  • Oversight of cash flows, subscription / redemption activity and operational support for Tokkin and pension account structures
  • Working with Japan Client Operations on account openings / closures with trust banks, custodians, outsourced partners and internal stakeholders

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience working with Japanese trust banks, custodians, brokers and outsourced operational service providers preferred
  • Native level language fluency in Japanese communication (reading, writing, speaking)
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and develop practical solutions to complex operational challenges
  • Leadership experience and ability to develop team capabilities and operational resiliency
  • Familiarity with Japanese market practices, Tokkin and pension account operational structures, and regulatory requirements
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills
  • Ability to manage complex operational activities across multiple internal and external parties
  • Ability to operate effectively under ambiguity and within evolving operational environments
  • Experience supporting operational initiatives, process improvements, and regulatory or market practice changes preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to balance local market requirements with global operating frameworks

Associate Engineer – BlackRock SMA Solutions

About BlackRock SMA Solutions:

At BlackRock SMA Solutions, our strategies are designed to put our clients’ and their clients’ interests at the center of our investment advice; to minimize costs and taxes; and to incorporate each client’s unique values-aligned preferences into their investment portfolio. We are a purposefully growing quantitative, multi-asset investment management business specializing in managing customized portfolios tax efficiently.

Technology is central to the success of the SMA business: on a daily basis our technology platform loads portfolio data; we raise and execute orders on our clients’ behalf; we gather security, index, and other essential reference data; we produce rich analytics to highlight risks; and we enable a strong investment research capability.

We are looking for talented and passionate engineers who like to innovate and seek complex problems. We recognize that strength comes from teams with a variety of perspectives, and will embrace your unique skills, curiosity, drive, and passion while giving you the opportunity to grow technically and as an individual. We are committed to open source and we regularly give our work back to the community. Engineers looking to work in the areas of orchestration, data modeling, data pipelines, APIs, storage, distribution, distributed computation, consumption and infrastructure are ideal candidates.  

About this Role:

We are expanding our team of engineers that owns and operates this extensive technology platform. As a member of this team, you will build, enhance, and support a wide variety of micro-services that enable financial portfolio construction, data integrations to connect diverse systems, and real-time operational workflows. You will work with your team and your stakeholders to ensure that platform capabilities address business needs in a complete and timely manner, with validated quality.

  • Strong Python or C# experience

  • Experience building and supporting production applications, services or APIs

Overview

Database Site Reliability Engineer

 

The Role

We are looking for a highly motivated engineer to join our Database team in a fast-paced, technology-driven financial environment.

This role would suit either an exceptional graduate with a strong technical foundation or an engineer in the early stages of their career who wants to develop deep expertise in database engineering.

We are looking for someone who is technically curious, learns quickly, enjoys understanding how complex systems work, and is particularly interested in how AI, automation and modern engineering practices can change the way database teams operate.

We want someone who will learn the fundamentals deeply, while also helping us rethink and automate how we work.

AI & Automation

A primary focus of the role initially will be exploring how AI can become part of the team’s everyday engineering workflow, identifying practical opportunities to improve how we investigate, automate and operate our database platforms.

We want you to help us identify and build practical uses of AI, including:

  • AI-assisted diagnosis of database and application performance issues
  • Analysing execution plans, SQL and database telemetry
  • Automating operational investigation and routine database workflows
  • Building internal tools and agents around database operations
  • Improving monitoring, alerting and incident investigation
  • Turning internal documentation and operational knowledge into useful AI-assisted tools
  • Using AI to accelerate scripting, engineering and problem solving

We are interested in practical applications that make engineers faster, improve how we work and make our systems more reliable.

Database Engineering

Alongside this, you will develop deep database engineering expertise across a large, mature estate supporting business-critical financial systems.

As you progress in the role, you will develop deeper expertise across areas including:

  • Database administration, performance and troubleshooting
  • SQL and PL/SQL performance analysis and optimisation
  • Database monitoring, capacity and reliability
  • Backup, recovery, resilience and disaster recovery
  • Linux and scripting
  • Database upgrades, patching and lifecycle management
  • Automation of repetitive operational tasks
  • Analysis of database performance and operational telemetry
  • Working with application and infrastructure engineering teams to diagnose complex production issues

What we're looking for

  •  

We need someone with strong aptitude, intellectual curiosity and an engineering mindset, who is motivated to learn quickly and tackle complex problems.

 

You should have:

  • A strong interest in databases and how complex systems behave
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability
  • A willingness to investigate problems deeply rather than stopping at the first explanation
  • Some programming or scripting experience
  • Good SQL fundamentals, or a strong desire to develop them
  • A strong interest in AI/LLMs and their practical application to engineering
  • The ability and motivation to learn quickly in a demanding technical environment
  • Good communication skills and the confidence to work with experienced engineers

Beneficial Experience

Experience or exposure to some of the following would be beneficial:

  • Oracle or other enterprise database platforms
  • Linux
  • Python or shell scripting
  • Cloud platforms
  • Infrastructure automation

Who We're Looking For

This role is suited to either a high-potential graduate with a strong technical foundation, or an early-career engineer who has already developed experience in databases, infrastructure or software engineering.

You might be:

A strong graduate in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical discipline who wants to develop deep expertise in databases and production engineering while working extensively with AI and automation.

Or:

An early-career engineer with approximately 1–3 years of experience who already understands some database or infrastructure fundamentals and wants significantly more technical depth and responsibility.

In either case, we are looking for someone with the curiosity, aptitude and drive to develop deep database engineering expertise while helping us accelerate the practical adoption of AI and automation.

 

The Environment

Our databases support a mature, high-performance financial technology environment.

The pace is fast, the systems matter, and the technical problems can be complex. You will work alongside experienced engineers and will be expected to learn quickly, ask good questions and progressively take ownership.

In return, this is an opportunity to develop deep database engineering expertise, gain hands-on experience in a demanding production environment, and apply AI to real-world infrastructure and operational challenges.

We want to develop an engineer who understands databases deeply and can help define what database engineering looks like in an AI-enabled organisation.

Recruiting Events + Conference Support

Hotels, Travel Coordination + Expenses

Employer Brand + Candidate Experience

Cross-Functional Partnership

What we're looking for

Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

Position Description

The Account Associate Group plays a dynamic role in supporting PIMCO’s Latin America institutional and retail clients. As an Account Analyst, you will gain hands-on exposure to client service, sales strategy, portfolio analysis, and fixed income markets while working closely with dedicated relationship teams in Account Management. You will collaborate across PIMCO to help deliver high-quality client service, support business development initiatives, and contribute to sales efforts across the region.

In this role, you will build a strong foundation in asset management through meaningful responsibilities, mentorship, and exposure to client-facing work. Account Analysts develop skills in market and portfolio analysis, client communication, CRM and pipeline management, and the thoughtful use of data, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, meeting preparation, and client insights.

Beyond day-to-day client service, Account Analysts play an important role in supporting the operating infrastructure of client coverage, including reporting, coordination, follow-up, and execution. The position offers a platform for long-term career development at PIMCO, with opportunities to build the skills needed for future client-facing, product specialist, or other roles across the firm.

Key Relationships

  • PIMCO Investment Professionals including other members of the Account Management Group, Product Managers and Associates, and Portfolio Managers and Trade Assistants.
  • PIMCO Fund Operations Group
  • Current and prospective clients.

About You

If you identify with the following qualities, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at PIMCO. We offer a dynamic work environment where you can make a meaningful impact:

  • Relationship-Oriented: You enjoy building trusted relationships and are motivated by client service, collaboration, and helping teams deliver thoughtful solutions.
  • Commercial Mindset: You are interested in sales, business development, and understanding how client needs translate into investment solutions and relationship opportunities.
  • Analytical & Insight-Driven: You are eager to analyze markets, portfolios, client activity, and business trends, and translate information into clear insights that support client engagement.
  • Technology-Forward: You are curious about data, automation, and AI-enabled tools, and are excited to learn how technology can improve reporting, meeting preparation, client insights, and overall efficiency.
  • Collaborative: You work well with colleagues across teams and levels, contribute positively to group efforts, and value diverse perspectives.
  • Organized & Accountable: You are detail-oriented, able to manage competing priorities, and committed to delivering high-quality work with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning quickly, navigating ambiguity, and adjusting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Curious & Driven: You have a strong interest in financial markets, fixed income, asset management, and ongoing professional development.
  • Aligned with PIMCO’s Values: You demonstrate integrity, sound judgment, and a commitment to PIMCO’s values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility, and Excellence.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to client service, business development, and relationship management efforts across PIMCO's Latin America business. Responsibilities include:

Institutional Account Analysts

  • Analyzing market trends, portfolio positioning, performance, and risk characteristics to develop client and business insights.
  • Creating client reporting and analytical deliverables that support relationship management and ongoing client service.
  • Conducting client, prospect, and industry research to support business development and relationship growth.
  • Leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, workflow efficiency, and client insights.
  • Maintaining CRM records and client activity tracking to support proactive coverage and business planning.
  • Partner across investment, product, and client-facing teams to support client relationships, business development efforts, and the delivery of a high-quality client experience.

Retail Account Analysts

  • Providing product information, market insights, and sales support to financial advisors and intermediary clients.
  • Researching clients, prospects, and market trends to identify opportunities for advisor engagement and business growth.
  • Build knowledge of PIMCO's investment philosophy, products, and market perspectives to support advisor education and client conversations.
  • Developing sales, marketing, and product materials that support business development and client servicing efforts.
  • Utilizing CRM, sales activity data, and AI-enabled tools to support outreach efforts, targeted campaigns, and relationship management.
  • Tracking client engagement and pipeline activity to support business planning and sales initiatives.
  • Partnering with distribution, product, and investment teams to deliver a consistent and high-quality client experience.

Position Qualifications

  • A minimum 3.2 overall GPA
  • 0-2 years of professional experience, including internships, with exposure to financial services, client-facing environments, sales, business development, or investment-related work preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with financial, CRM, and data-management tools.
  • Interest in leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled technologies to generate insights and improve business outcomes.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate effectively across teams, and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic environment.

About this role

Job Overview
Lead the Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) program across BlackRock’s India operations, ensuring a safe, healthy, and sustainable work environment in alignment with global standards, local regulatory requirements, and best practices.

 This role will manage India HSE, with direct responsibility for the India North campus (Gurgaon) and oversight of HSE delivery across all India locations. The role will line manage the India West South HSE Manager (Mumbai/Bangalore) and partner closely with Workplace Operations, Security, Enterprise Resilience, HR, and business leadership to drive a strong safety culture and consistent execution across the region.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day HSE execution for the Gurgaon campus, including risk identification, mitigation, and operational delivery.

  • Serve as the site subject matter expert, providing hands-on guidance to local stakeholders and supporting projects, workplace changes, and incident management.

  • Ensure strong on-the-ground presence through inspections, audits, and engagement activities.

  • Line manage and provide direction to the India West South HSE Manager, supporting capability development, prioritization, and performance delivery.

  • Oversee development and maintenance of the India HSE risk register, ensuring effective controls for key risks (e.g., fire safety, ergonomics, contractor safety).

  • Ensure compliance with Indian HSE laws and regulations (e.g., Factories Act, Fire Safety Rules, environmental requirements).

  • Ensure consistent application of global programs (ergonomics, incident management, food safety, etc.) across all sites.

  • Manage emergency preparedness, including fire safety, evacuation planning, drills, emergency roles, equipment and training.

  • Manage incident reporting, investigation, and corrective action tracking across the region.

  • Ensure delivery of regular HSE inspections, audits, and walkthroughs across all locations.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on data insights and risk trends.

  • Promote a strong safety culture through awareness campaigns, communications, and leadership engagement.

  • Ensure all vendors, contractors, and project teams comply with BlackRock HSE standards and permit-to-work requirements.

  • Oversee contractor onboarding, inductions, and safety governance across projects and sites. 

 

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in HSE, Industrial Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health, or related field.

  • NEBOSH International General Certificate/Diploma, ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent certification preferred.

  • 8-10 years of HSE experience, including experience managing multi-site or regional programs.

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams or managing regional HSE delivery.

  • Strong knowledge of Indian HSE regulations and global safety standards.

  • Experience in corporate office environments, multi-site portfolios, or complex campus settings preferred.

  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to operate across strategic and operational levels.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

IMC is looking for experienced quant researchers to develop high frequency delta one trading strategies and predictive models for the APAC markets. If you’re excited about helping to push the boundaries of what we can do with Machine Learning in trading, unlocking the significant edges we have in execution, and collaborating to become the best trading firm worldwide, this may be the role for you.

You will be responsible for performing large scale data analysis to derive statistically profitable predictions of market behaviour. These predictions are used to inform all of our trading, and improvements have a high and visible impact across the office. You will also help to shape the direction we take across research and tooling. We have longstanding and significant edges across market access, global reach, Options understanding and low latency. The rapid growth we’ve already seen in Machine Learning has unlocked these edges, and some of the most interesting and impactful problems are now being tackled.

You will work as part of an established and growing research team, collaborating closely with traders, software and hardware developers to find improvements to our models and see them impact our production results. IMC competes and wins as a team, with open idea sharing and collaboration across disciplines, desks and offices.

Your Core Responsibilities: 

  • Combine creativity and experience to rapidly generate high quality, testable alpha signals
  • Refine and leverage deep understanding of market microstructure and order book dynamics, to create powerful features
  • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques with strong discipline around robustness and overfitting
  • Collaborate closely with trading and engineering teams to translate research into production strategies

Your Skills and Experience: 

  • 3+ years of experience in high-frequency equities or futures alpha research, ideally with prior track record in at least one of the Asia markets
  • Strong foundation in probability and statistics, and significant practical experience with at least one mainstream ML approach
  • Experience working with large, high-frequency trading datasets
  • Excellent programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
  • Practical mindset with a focus on deployable, real-world edge

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

We are looking for an experienced Compliance Specialist to own and grow our control room function in Hong Kong. This team decides when Jane Street should stop trading a name — for example, if we've been wall-crossed on a deal, or due to sanctions or other regulatory concerns.

Our trading business in Asia is growing quickly, and the volume and variety of restrictions we handle is growing with it.   • Advising traders, our Business Development team, and other teams on what a restriction means in practice
  • Owning the policies and procedures behind these business lines and processes, and keeping them accurate as our business, systems and regulations change
  • Handling sanctions and government-driven trading restrictions and monitoring for any changes that affect us
  • Supporting surveillance, look-back reviews, and information barrier and clean room arrangements where MNPI is involved
  • Continuing to build and evolve our control room function over time

  • Comfortable making judgment or escalation calls under time pressure

The role is responsible for overseeing financial reporting and consolidations, preparing technical accounting memoranda, strengthening internal controls, supporting management reporting, leading treasury activities, and driving operational excellence across the finance organization. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires an entrepreneurial mindset. The successful candidate will play a key role in building a solid foundation for Brookfield Credit's finance operations by establishing scalable processes, developing best practices, and implementing appropriate controls in an environment where many procedures continue to evolve. The ideal candidate is highly adaptable, comfortable working through ambiguity, and capable of independently identifying issues, developing solutions, and executing strategic and operational initiatives.

Controllership, Financial Reporting & Consolidation

  • Provide guidance to the controllership team for quarter-end and annual financial close across multiple legal entities.
  • Oversee the preparation and review of financial consolidations, including intercompany eliminations and consolidation adjustments.
  • Prepare financial analysis, management reporting, and presentation materials to support senior leadership's decision-making and strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with Brookfield accounting policies and applicable accounting standards (IFRS and/or U.S. GAAP).
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support audit requests.
  • Lead initiatives to improve financial reporting, consolidation processes, and operational effectiveness.
  • Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, and ad hoc analyses in support of evolving business priorities.

Technical Accounting

  • Research complex accounting issues and prepare technical accounting memoranda supporting significant transactions.
  • Evaluate accounting implications of investments, restructurings, acquisitions, dispositions, and treasury activities.

Treasury Operations

  • Oversee day-to-day treasury operations for Brookfield Credit entities
  • Manage banking relationships, account administration, payment approvals, cash positioning, and liquidity management.
  • Review and approve wire transfers and treasury transactions in accordance with internal control policies.
  • Coordinate funding activities, capital calls, distributions, and intercompany cash movements.
  • Develop and implement best practices for treasury operations to improve efficiency, scalability, and control.

Accounts Payable Oversight

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex Accounts Payable issues and payment exceptions.
  • Partner with AP teams and business stakeholders to resolve vendor inquiries, payment delays, banking issues, and operational challenges.
  • Monitor outstanding items and drive timely resolution of aged transactions.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline AP workflows and strengthen operational controls.

Systems, Process Improvement & Microsoft Dynamics

  • Act as a business owner for Microsoft Dynamics Finance processes related to treasury, accounts payable, and controllership.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve system utilization.

Leadership, Training & Team Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop members of the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and deliver training on treasury operations, financial close, internal controls, and Microsoft Dynamics best practices.

Desired Experience & Attributes

  • CPA, CA (or equivalent) preferred; degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
  • 8–15+ years of progressive experience in treasury, controllership, accounting, or finance, preferably within asset management, private credit, or financial services.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and/or U.S. GAAP
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment with limited established processes.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

BPMT acts as the connective tissue between investment professionals, product strategy, engineering delivery, data integrity, operating controls, analytics, reporting, and user adoption.   • Drive Private Markets Technology Strategy: Partner directly with investment teams, product strategy, engineering, data, operations, and risk stakeholders to translate private markets growth objectives into actionable technology roadmaps, capability maps, and implementation plans.

  • Analytical and Technical Fluency: Strong analytical orientation and comfort working with data, platforms, reporting, analytics, and technical teams. Vice President – Fund Finance – New York

Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), a part of BlackRock

About this Role

The GIP Infrastructure Credit platform invests across all major infrastructure markets and sectors, spanning the full capital structure and offering both investment grade and non-investment grade strategies. The team has deployed nearly c.$27bn across more than 270 investments globally. GIP's Infrastructure Debt business originates, structures and manages infrastructure investments designed to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns with a focus on capital preservation and income generation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated and experienced professional to join the Fund Finance team supporting GIP's Infrastructure Debt platform globally.

The successful candidate will play a central role in the operational and strategic management of the Global Infrastructure Debt ("GID") platform, GIP's flagship non-investment grade commingled fund platform, which invests across a broad range of infrastructure sectors and debt structures, including senior secured, second lien and holding company financings. Working closely with Investment Teams, Asset Management, Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Legal, Tax, Portfolio Compliance and Investor Relations, the individual will help drive the effective management and continued growth of the platform.

The role spans the full investment lifecycle from transaction execution and portfolio construction through to liquidity management, valuations, financing oversight, reporting and investor servicing, while also supporting the continued evolution of the platform and launch of new products.

The successful candidate will have significant exposure to a broad range of structures including:

  • Leveraged and unlevered commingled funds
  • Rated note structures (vertical and horizontal)
  • Asset-backed lending facilities
  • Subscription and fund financing facilities
  • Collateralized Fund Obligations (CFOs)
  • Separately Managed Accounts (SMAs)
  • Fund-of-One mandates

This is a highly visible role with regular interaction with senior management, investors, rating agencies, fund administrators and external counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

Fund Oversight & Investment Execution

  • Act as a senior Fund Finance lead supporting the GID platform and associated feeder, financing and leverage vehicles.
  • Partner with Investment Teams throughout the investment lifecycle to ensure efficient onboarding, execution and ongoing management of investments across participating funds and mandates.
  • Lead allocation review processes and confirm adherence to allocation policies, investment guidelines and portfolio construction objectives.
  • Oversee transaction execution and settlement activities, resolving operational issues relating to compliance, settlement, funding, hedging and reporting.
  • Coordinate with borrowers, sponsors, lenders, legal counsel and external service providers to support execution and ongoing management of investments.
  • Maintain strong operational controls and ensure accurate investment setup and lifecycle management within Aladdin.
  • Review valuation outputs and challenge significant movements, assumptions or anomalies.
  • Partner with investment teams, valuation providers and pricing specialists to ensure robust valuation governance.

Liquidity Management & Financing Structures

  • Lead liquidity management across the GID fund complex, including cash forecasting, unfunded commitments, deployment planning and dry-powder management.
  • Determine optimal funding strategies through a combination of:
    • Investor capital calls
    • Subscription facilities
    • Asset-backed lending facilities
    • Fund-level leverage arrangements
  • Coordinate capital calls, fund borrowings, distributions and debt service obligations across fund structures.
  • Oversee ongoing management of financing facilities, including:
    • Borrowing base calculations
    • Covenant monitoring
    • Utilization management
    • Lender reporting requirements
  • Partner with Treasury, Asset Management, NAV Oversight and Fund Accounting teams to optimize liquidity and minimize cash drag.

Structured Products & Complex Fund Vehicles

  • Support operational oversight of rated note structures, securitization vehicles and other structured financing solutions utilized across the platform.
  • Monitor structural tests, waterfalls, reserve requirements and reporting obligations associated with leveraged vehicles.
  • Support the launch and implementation of new products, including leveraged funds, CFOs, ABL structures and bespoke client solutions.

Reporting, Client Support & Regulatory Oversight

  • Oversee production and review of investor reporting, management reporting, financial reporting and board materials.
  • Support responses to investor due diligence requests, operational reviews and ad hoc client enquiries.
  • Coordinate investor-specific reporting obligations, side letter requirements and bespoke reporting solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory reporting requirements across all applicable structures.
  • Provide management information and strategic insights to senior stakeholders.
  • Review operational implementation of client commitments and reporting obligations across the platform.

Platform Development & Leadership

  • Drive operational scalability across a rapidly growing infrastructure debt platform.
  • Lead initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, data governance and AI-enabled workflow improvements.
  • Enhance reporting and data capabilities through Power BI and other technology solutions.
  • Develop and document controls, procedures and best practices across the Core PM function.
  • Support operational implementation of new products and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Mentor and develop junior members of the Fund Finance team.
  • Act as a key stakeholder across cross-functional initiatives supporting the broader BlackRock and GIP operating model.

Candidate Profile

Required Experience

  • Relevant experience within private credit, infrastructure debt, structured finance, fund finance, asset management, fund operations, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of increasing responsibility and expertise.
  • Strong understanding of closed-ended private fund structures and institutional investor requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex fund operations, liquidity processes and capital activity.
  • Experience coordinating capital calls, distributions, financing activities and investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of fund accounting, fund administration and valuation processes.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Private credit or infrastructure debt strategies.
  • Leveraged private fund structures.
  • Asset-backed lending facilities.
  • Subscription line facilities.
  • Rated note structures.
  • Collateralized Fund Obligations (CFOs).
  • Securitization vehicles.
  • Structured finance transactions.
  • Institutional SMAs and Fund-of-One structures.
  • Fund launches and product development initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • ACA, ACCA, CFA, CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or related discipline.
  • Strong analytical, financial modelling and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Experience with Aladdin, Power BI, SQL, Python or similar data platforms is advantageous.

Development Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to operate at the center of one of the industry's largest and most sophisticated infrastructure debt platforms. The successful candidate will gain exposure to a diverse range of institutional vehicles and financing structures, including leveraged funds, rated note programs, ABL facilities, CFO structures, SMAs and bespoke client mandates.

This role provides significant interaction with senior investment professionals and leadership teams while offering the opportunity to shape the continued evolution of GIP's global Infrastructure Debt platform.

About Bridgewater  
Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors.  
Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world’s markets and economies work — using cutting-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles.  
Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment to excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture.  
Explore more information about Bridgewater on our website here.  
Our Culture  
Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it’s the engine that powers everything else. 
Explore more information about Bridgewater’s culture on our website here.

Role Summary

The Portfolio Specialist is a member of the Investment Division and a key member of the Target Date investment team. The position serves as a critical link between portfolio management, distribution, clients, and broader business partners. It requires deep investment and retirement expertise, strong commercial judgment, and close collaboration with portfolio managers to help position, represent, and develop our capabilities.

This role will partner with the existing Target Date Portfolio Specialist to serve as strategic leads for investment messaging across assigned strategies. The role is both investment-led and client-facing. The Portfolio Specialist helps advance prospective opportunities by working closely with portfolio analysts, institutional writers, RFP editors, and other associates, while also playing a key role in retaining existing client assets.

The role requires the ability to lead high-impact engagements with clients and prospects to better understand their specific needs, identify potential solutions utilizing existing capabilities, and translate insights from across our investment platform into clear and compelling messages for clients, prospects, consultants, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a core member of the Target Date Solutions investment team, contributing to portfolio, market, performance, client, product, and broader franchise discussions.
  • Serve as a key contributor to the strategy’s commercial and investment narrative, ensuring clear, consistent, and compelling messaging across diverse audiences.
  • Build deep partnerships with portfolio managers to accurately represent their investment process, positioning, and views, while serving as an extension of the investment team with clients, prospects, consultants, and distribution partners.

  • Bring the voice of the client and market back to the investment team, synthesizing insights from clients, consultants, Distribution, competitors, and industry trends to help inform positioning, messaging, and franchise priorities.

  • Serve as a senior investment resource for internal partners, helping Distribution and other stakeholders deepen their understanding of Target Date investing, our capabilities, and how best to position them with clients.
  • Travel regularly to support investment team, client, and Distribution efforts.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in the investment management industry. Relevant experience may include investment research, portfolio analysis, investment consulting, or institutional/intermediary client service.
  • Willingness and ability to travel.
  • Passion for the investment management business, with a deep understanding of investment concepts and a strong working knowledge of investment strategies and portfolio management.
  • Demonstrated track record of effectively communicating complex concepts to a wide variety of audiences.
  • Exceptional relationship-management skills and the ability to interact effectively with investment professionals, sales and client service professionals, institutional and intermediary clients, and consultants.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop compelling presentations that translate complex financial data into clear, visually engaging, and easily digestible content, in partnership with the Presentation Design Team.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including experience managing or helping lead a strategy, franchise, or product group.
  • Client-facing experience.

Preferred:

Overview

Heights Capital Management Asia (HCMA), an investment team within Susquehanna International Group (Susquehanna), is hiring an Equity Capital Markets Manager for our Hong Kong office. We support great founders and managers growing companies across Asia-Pacific with flexible capital. You join a dynamic and cohesive team under one of the world's largest pools of permanent capital, in an entrepreneurial role where results matter more than facetime. Success requires a sophisticated, practical understanding of Asia-Pacific equity and equity-linked capital markets, the judgment to navigate complex, multi-party deals, and the drive to win where the best opportunities are competitive.

The Role

You help us source the companies and financing opportunities worth backing. Day to day, that begins in equity capital markets: building deep relationships with the banks and brokers who captain ECM deals across Asia-Pacific by being genuinely useful to them. That means catalyzing deals, giving timely and independent feedback, managing expectations early, and helping ECM deals close predictably and with integrity. It is steady, consistent work that compounds over time, and it rewards judgment over words and bravado.

Some of those relationships lead to privately negotiated investments in listed companies, where our permanent, flexible capital matters most. We have a strong track record of backing companies through multiple capital raises over the long term, taking significant market risk, and customizing investments to help founders and managers execute their strategies on their own timelines. You do not need to have done these deals before. If you have worked on convertibles, equity-linked deals, or corporate derivatives, you already understand the building blocks. Working alongside the broader HCMA team, you will contribute to evaluating opportunities, support companies beyond the close, and help grow HCMA. We want someone who thinks independently but works cooperatively, inside and out, to help everyone involved make great decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with issuer founders and management, institutional partners, bankers, and brokers, across both Asia-direct channels and international capital market syndicates, so that Heights is well positioned with all the decision makers and stakeholders.
  • Opportunity Identification: Work with the broader Heights team, bankers, and brokers across the full range of deals, from regular-way ECM to privately negotiated investments.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough diligence on target companies, including meeting management teams, site visits, sector analysis, credit analysis, and market research, to judge each opportunity and assess its risks.
  • Transaction Execution: Work deals from the investor's side of the table: taking wall-crosses, handling NDAs, negotiation, structuring, closing, and post-investment support.
  • Communication: Prepare thoughtful, well-supported analysis and presentations for founders, management teams, and internal discussions. We value intellectual honesty, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to challenge assumptions.
  • Market Analysis: Monitor market trends and developments to spot new opportunities and stay ahead of industry change.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • Substantial experience (typically around seven years or more) in equity capital markets, investment banking, or a closely related field, with a real track record of sourcing, negotiating, and executing deals. We care more about the depth and quality of that experience than the number of years.
  • A mind that thinks in instruments and structures, not just single-period valuation multiples, fluent in at least one of convertibles or equity-linked securities, options or corporate derivatives, or other structured-equity instruments, and able to see how a structure shifts risk and reward between a company and its investors. You do not need to have done PIPEs or private placements; we teach you that.
  • Direct relationships with company management, IR, and the banks and brokers who run deals across Asia.
  • Respect for the market and a close read of consensus, with the confidence to offer your own independent, rational judgments even when unpopular, to help everyone make the best decisions.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the competence and enthusiasm to read financial statements and legal documents carefully.
  • Fluent English, our working language. Because the role involves engaging directly with brokers, founders, and management across Asia-Pacific, fluency in one or more additional regional languages relevant to our markets may be advantageous. We are open-minded on the combination and assess language skills against the needs of the role, regardless of background.
  • Proficiency in Bloomberg, Excel, and PowerPoint, and in leveraging AI to improve productivity and creativity. A degree in finance, economics, engineering, or a related field; a JD, MBA, or CPA would be a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience with PIPEs, private placements, or other privately negotiated investments.
  • Interest in technology, biotech, or other high-growth industries.
  • Intellectual curiosity, a drive to keep learning, and creative problem-solving.
  • Comfortable with people at every level of seniority, and at home in a flat, entrepreneurial, multicultural team.

What We Offer

  • We teach. Several of our team came from the sell side and learned structured, principal investing here, mentored by people who have done it for decades.
  • A results-focused environment where contribution matters more than facetime. We measure what you actually sourced, judged, taught, and turned into workflows that build the business.
  • As part of a small, entrepreneurial Asia team, you help shape how we work and contribute to the growth of HCMA, while drawing on the resources and stability of one of the world's largest pools of permanent capital.

Company Description

HCMA is an affiliate of Susquehanna, one of the world's largest privately held financial services firms. Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. That approach runs through our culture: in each of our core disciplines, Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research, you find relentless problem solvers who collaborate to make optimal decisions and who are driven to achieve winning results together.

About the Position

We're looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You'll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models.

We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street's research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualisation, and machine learning.

Beyond our own environment, we also recognise the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We're also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we're interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined.

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of our newest hires.

About You

We don't expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we're looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • A top-notch programmer with a love for technology
  • Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes
  • Fluency in English required

 

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

Job Description

The Staff Security Engineer, Cloud & AI Platform is a deeply technical, hands-on role responsible for making Brookfield Real Estate’s cloud and AI platforms secure by design. You will lead security architecture and implementation across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, software delivery, internally developed applications, and AI/agent systems.

This is a builder role. You will threat-model a design, review the underlying Terraform and application code, implement the control, instrument it, and help teams adopt it without unnecessary friction. Security requirements become reusable modules, automated checks, secure defaults, and clear engineering guidance rather than documents and findings lists.

You will partner closely with Cloud Solutions, application engineering, AI engineering, Identity, CyberOps, and GRC/Privacy. Platform engineering continues to own general platform uptime, capacity, and deployment mechanics, and CyberOps continues to own alert triage; this role owns the architecture, controls, tooling, and assurance mechanisms that make those systems safe.

Role & Responsibilities:

Leadership & Security Architecture

  • Help define security architecture for the cloud and AI platforms: set direction, write specs, and steward secure-by-default patterns across teams
  • Define security engineering standards and paved roads, document important decisions, and communicate risk and trade-offs to engineering and business leadership
  • Review infrastructure and application designs for authorization, network, data-protection, secrets, and tenant-isolation risks
  • Mentor engineers and raise the organization’s ability to make sound security decisions independently
  • Partner with Cloud Solutions, application engineering, AI engineering, Identity, CyberOps, and GRC/Privacy to prioritize work and drive adoption

Cloud & Identity Security

  • Own and evolve security architecture for a multi-account AWS organization — account boundaries, service control policies, IAM Identity Center, delegated security services, KMS, VPC controls, and WAF
  • Design least-privilege human and workload access across AWS, Okta, GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code platforms using federation and short-lived credentials
  • Build and maintain reusable security controls in Terraform or OpenTofu, with safe rollout, testing, monitoring, and recovery patterns
  • Strengthen centralized logging and evidence — CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Macie, and CloudWatch — and keep guardrails current as the environment grows

Secure Software Delivery

  • Establish secure GitHub Actions and runner patterns, including OIDC trust, environment separation, workflow protection, action pinning, artifact integrity, and least-privilege deployment roles
  • Integrate practical security checks into developer workflows — secrets detection, dependency and container scanning, SBOMs, Infrastructure as Code analysis, code scanning, and risk-based release gates
  • Support vulnerability management for internally developed software, from detection and prioritization through remediation evidence and exception handling. Partner with the Vulnerability Manager to establish prioritization and reduce false positives
  • Improve controls with engineers rather than around them, avoiding noisy or easily bypassed gates

Application & AI Security

  • Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for web applications, APIs, data ingestion, authentication and authorization flows, and agentic systems
  • Define secure patterns for Amazon Bedrock and other model platforms, including model access, guardrail lifecycle, invocation logging, usage attribution, and sensitive-data controls
  • Harden agent tools, MCP servers, gateways, sandboxes, and code-execution environments against prompt injection, confused-deputy attacks, excessive agency, secret disclosure, data exfiltration, and cross-tenant access
  • Build repeatable security evaluations and adversarial tests for AI-enabled features and connect findings to engineering remediation

Detection, Response & Assurance

  • Translate cloud and application telemetry into actionable detections, runbooks, ownership, and escalation paths in partnership with CyberOps
  • Lead technical response and root-cause remediation for cloud, identity, software supply chain, and AI security incidents
  • Establish severity and ownership standards for cloud findings, software vulnerabilities, and AI security issues, with clear remediation expectations
  • Produce the control evidence GRC and Privacy need, without turning engineering work into manual reporting

  • Deep AWS security experience across IAM, multi-account or AWS Organizations environments, logging and detection, KMS, networking, and service-to-service authorization
  • Strong Terraform or OpenTofu skills, including modular design, remote execution, policy controls, and safe state-aware changes
  • Experience securing CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, including OIDC federation, runner trust boundaries, secrets, artifacts, and deployment permissions
  • Working knowledge of application security fundamentals: threat modeling, authentication and authorization, secure API design, secrets handling, dependency risk, and vulnerability remediation
  • Ability to read and write production-quality automation or application code in Python, Go, Ruby, or a comparable language
  • Demonstrated ability to influence teams you do not manage, make pragmatic risk decisions, and turn ambiguous security needs into implemented controls

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, MCP, LLM gateways, AI guardrails, or production agentic systems
  • Container and orchestration security — ECS/Fargate or EKS, image supply chains, runtime isolation, and egress control

Job Overview

This role will build and lead a new enterprise Identity & Access Management (IAM) Platform team. It is a unique opportunity to shape a critical capability from the ground up assessing today’s environment, defining the future state, and leading a multi-year transformation while keeping existing identity services secure and reliable.

You will partner with leaders across technology, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, audit, and the business to understand pain points, align priorities, and develop a practical strategy for modernizing IAM. You will establish the team, operating model, architecture, governance, and roadmap for identity governance, access management, privileged access, and human and non-human identities.

The role requires deep experience designing, building, and modernizing IAM capabilities at enterprise scale. The successful candidate will serve as the technical authority for the IAM platform, setting the architectural vision, establishing engineering standards, reviewing critical designs, and partnering closely with engineers throughout implementation. You should be comfortable diving deep into complex identity challenges and contributing directly when needed, without being expected to be the hands-on expert in every IAM product.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical depth with strategic thinking, proven managerial experience, and the ability to translate an ambitious vision into a practical, executable program.

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the new IAM Platform team, including its mission, structure, capabilities, and ways of working.

  • Assess the current identity environment, processes, controls, integrations, and stakeholder pain points.

  • Define the IAM strategy, target-state architecture, operating model, and multi-year transformation roadmap. This includes driving detailed architecture and design based on experience of building these systems at enterprise scale.

  • Create an executable program plan covering investment, resources, priorities, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to build alignment, make trade-offs, and drive adoption.

  • Guide the evaluation and selection of IAM and IGA platforms, vendors, and implementation partners.

  • Oversee the modernization of identity governance, authentication, authorization, privileged access, and human and non-human identity management.

  • Lead the phased migration from legacy capabilities while maintaining service continuity, security, and regulatory compliance.

  • Strengthen IAM controls, including joiner/mover/leaver processes, access reviews, least privilege, audit evidence, and SOC 1 requirements.

  • Establish platform performance, risk, control, adoption, and service-reliability measures.

Qualifications

  • Experience developing an enterprise strategy, target operating model, architecture, or transformation roadmap.

  • Demonstrated experience architecting, building, integrating, or operating enterprise-scale IAM platforms—not solely managing IAM programs or vendors.

  • Ability to move comfortably between enterprise strategy and detailed technical discussions, including reviewing solution designs, challenging architectural assumptions, and guiding engineering teams through implementation.

  • Strong understanding of identity architecture and integration patterns across cloud, SaaS, internally developed applications, APIs, and legacy environments.

  • Strong knowledge of core IAM and IGA concepts, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorization, federation, and privileged access.

  • Strong understanding of OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SAML, delegated authorization, On-Behalf-Of flows, and service-to-service authentication.

  • Practical experience with one or more leading identity ecosystems, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, AWS IAM, SailPoint, Saviynt, Omada, One Identity, or comparable solutions. Candidates are not expected to be experts in every product, but should have the technical depth to evaluate platforms, guide integrations, and make sound architecture decisions.

  • Experience leading complex technology transformation or modernization initiatives while supporting existing services.

  • Ability to engage senior leaders, uncover organizational pain points, build consensus, and translate needs into practical priorities.

  • Strong communication and program leadership skills, with the ability to explain technical and risk topics to diverse audiences.

  • Experience establishing or significantly transforming an IAM platform or team is preferred

  • Knowledge of non-human identities, workload identities, service accounts, secrets management, or AI agent identities is highly desired.

  • Experience in a regulated or highly controlled environment, including familiarity with SOC 1 or similar controls is an asset.

Hudson River Trading (HRT) is looking for an Electronic Trading Support Engineer to join our global Trade Operations (TradeOps) team in NYC. This team is responsible for managing HRT’s live trading environment, one of the most robust and efficient electronic trading platforms in the world. This includes configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the firm’s trading as well as handling risk, regulatory, and development tasks. The TradeOps team focuses on both automating common tasks and preparing for the unexpected. Your day could consist of debugging to get a process running in time for the market open, making a difficult on-the-spot decision that balances compliance, risk, and PnL during trading hours, or coordinating the technical rollout of a new trading strategy. 

Being a member of TradeOps at HRT means working on a tight-knit, highly productive team. We're looking for someone who loves technology and wants to work on a broad range of projects using whatever tool(s) best solve the problem at hand. Excellent communication is a must, along with a can-do attitude.

Role

In a high performance environment, immediate awareness of and reaction to systems and trading issues is essential. That’s where HRT’s Electronic Trading Support Engineers come in. You’ll be responsible for managing new initiatives and ensuring a smooth trading day. You’ll act as the first line of defense when the inevitable happens, and the subject matter expert on recent changes to the production trading platform. The team’s scope covers everything from systems infrastructure, to compliance, risk management, overnight clearing, and performance improvement. 

Responsibilities 

  • Support live trading during US market hours
  • Handle order flow from HRT’s trading desks
  • Respond to external market alerts and outages
  • Interface with exchanges & other external parties to support trading 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (CS, Engineering, Physics, Math, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX systems
  • Experience with a scripting language (Python, Perl, Bash)
  • Excellent communication skills and enjoy interfacing with clients, both internal and external
  • Incredibly organized, with a high attention to detail
  • Excited to work independently in a very fast-paced, high pressure environment
  • Poses an understanding of Market Data/Order Entry systems and an interest in how modern electronic markets work
  • Industry experience and/or Series 7 or 57 certification is preferred

The estimated base salary range for this position is 100,000 to 150,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.
