SpiderRock Advisors (SRA) is a Chicago-based asset manager specializing in listed derivatives, options overlay strategies, and separately managed accounts. We have built our platform serving RIAs, private wealth platforms, and family offices, and that foundation is now extending into the institutional market, where we are expanding our presence with asset owners, consultants, and platform partners.

We are seeking a Vice President, Institutional Client Solutions to lead client engagement across our institutional effort and act as the connective tissue between clients, portfolio management, sales, trading, and operations. This is a commercial, client-facing investment seat: the person in this role will help shape how SRA shows up institutionally, grow assets in a segment we are actively building, support and defend relationships across our wealth channel, and serve as a credible investment voice with CIOs, consultants, and platform partners.

Job Purpose

The successful candidate will own clients across the full relationship lifecycle: new business support and diligence, implementation, ongoing portfolio reviews, performance and attribution analysis, and strategic relationship management. They will develop into the firm's subject matter expert on SRA strategies for recurring client and consultant engagement, creating leverage for portfolio managers and senior business development professionals.

This role sits within a growing function. As the Institutional Client Solutions team scales, we anticipate supervisory and team-building responsibilities for the right candidate, including mentoring junior strategists and eventually managing analysts supporting the platform.

Asset Growth and Retention

Client Ownership

  • Own day-to-day relationships with institutional clients, consultants, and internal stakeholders, resolving questions independently and escalating only where warranted.
  • Lead client review meetings, portfolio discussions, and diligence sessions alongside portfolio management, and independently where appropriate.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of each client's objectives, constraints, and decision-making process, and position SRA within the client's broader portfolio.

Investment Analysis and Portfolio Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert across SRA investment strategies, options overlay solutions, portfolio construction methodologies, and implementation considerations.
  • Analyze and explain portfolio performance, attribution, exposures, and trade activity, connecting outcomes to market developments and the portfolio management team's active views.

  • Drive improvements to reporting, workflow, and automation that increase scalability across the client lifecycle.

As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident. 

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.  

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you. 

Role Summary 

Serve as a key partner to T. Rowe Price’s intermediary sales organization, supporting both desk and field sales teams through analytical insights, strategic coordination, and client engagement. ISAs play a critical role in helping drive sales effectiveness and ensure a high-quality client experience across multiple distribution channels.   

  

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a key member of dedicated sales teams including completing complex sales support activities, scheduling meetings, pre-meeting preparation, and promotion of targeted product and marketing campaigns.  
  • Analyze performance, sales, and client activity reports to identify trends, risks, and opportunities in partnership with sales teams to best inform coverage and engagement strategies. 
  • Primary point of contact for inbound calls from financial professionals, effectively triaging requests to sales team to deliver timely and high-quality solutions. 
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of T. Rowe Price products, marketing strategies and capital markets to fully support and service FAs and internal/external sales teams. 
  • Support digital only FAs via personalized outbound calls/email campaigns to promote T. Rowe Price solutions and products.  
  • Cultivate strong relationships with desk and field sales teams to become the "go to" person for  Wirehouse, independent, RIA, and other financial firm specific information.  

  

Qualifications  

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.  
  • 2+ years of total relevant work experience.  
  • FINRA Series 7 and 66 licenses, as well as registration with the National Futures Association (NFA). Licenses may be obtained within first 6 months of hire if not currently held.  

Preferred:

  • College degree with concentration in business or finance.
  • Client facing experience and demonstrated commitment to client service.
  • Strong relationship management, critical thinking and interpersonal skills.  
  • Excellent verbal, written communication and presentation skills.  
  • Able to work in a team environment while being a self-starter.  
  • Intellectual curiosity about financial markets, investment products, and intermediary distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment.
  • Ability to influence without authority and partner effectively across teams.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are required and will be supported for this role.

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to one day per week from home.

This role provides exposure to intermediary distribution strategy and is designed to build a strong foundation for growth within Sales or other client-facing roles at T. Rowe Price.

WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING

1. You will receive an email and text message to answer a few questions to verify your eligibility. If you apply for multiple jobs, you will receive separate invitations for each role and will need to respond to each. Estimated Time Commitment: 3-5 minutes

2. If you are eligible, you will be asked to record video responses to introductory questions with our vendor partner, HireVue. Take time to read all instructions carefully before responding. Some questions may require you to respond within a set time limit, or with limited retakes. You can use this opportunity to tell us more about your background and interest than we can learn from a resume alone. Estimated Time Commitment: 20-30 minutes

Two Sigma is a leading quantitative investment management and trading firm. The company applies a scientific approach to investing, combining cutting-edge technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and quantitative research with rigorous human inquiry to capitalize on market opportunities and deliver alpha for investors.

Our team of engineers, quantitative researchers and data scientists looks beyond the traditional to test hypotheses and develop creative solutions to some of the world’s most complex economic problems.
Two Sigma Securities brings a scientific approach to systematic trading and risk management to make markets more efficient. Our team trades over 10,000 US equities and 4,000 listed options, leveraging our high performance trading system to execute over 850 million shares per day. Two Sigma Securities is entering an exciting growth phase. We value the insights of our colleagues and encourage them to innovate and shape their own work agenda. New joiners use our proprietary platform to work on diverse projects. From building next generation trading technologies and researching novel AI and machine learning techniques to enhancing our strategies and deploying automation, our team is pushing the frontier in systematic trading.
We are looking for a Production Engineer with a strong technical development background to join our dynamic, fast-paced team. This role will involve building and supporting our trading environments in the US, Asia and Europe, as well as contributing to our advancement into digital assets trading. Our Production Engineering team is primarily focused on developing tools, automated testing and integration software, maintaining infrastructure, real-time monitoring, performance measurement, and managing the release and deployment lifecycle. This is an exciting and impactful opportunity where you will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficiency and reliability of our electronic trading systems, working closely with our quantitative traders and researchers. 
You will take on the following responsibilities:
  • Develop and maintain scalable, ultra-low latency systems focused on automation, including deploying new features and fixes for a global multi-asset electronic trading business.
  • Enhance real-time monitoring and refine incident and crisis management SLOs, diagnosing and resolving issues with intraday transactions.
  • Design and implement architecture and support for the proprietary trading environment, including system design consulting, platform management, capacity planning, tools development, network, colocation site management, and vendor/exchange connectivity across three continents.
  • Collaborate with software and infrastructure teams to define and improve technical and operational best practices.

You should possess the following qualifications:
  • Minimum 1 year of experience required; 1-5 years of experience preferred in Production or Reliability Engineering
  • BS in a relevant discipline is required
  • Ability to program (structured and OO) with one or more high level language (such as Python, Java, C++)
  • Proven track record for automating processes combined with an algorithmic approach to solving problems
  • Ability to profile and debug applications in real time
  • Trading domain and order lifecycle management knowledge is a plus
You will enjoy the following benefits:
  • Core Benefits: Fully paid medical and dental insurance premiums for employees and dependents, competitive 401k match, employer-paid life & disability insurance
  • Perks: Onsite gyms with laundry service, wellness activities, casual dress, snacks, game rooms
  • Learning: Tuition reimbursement, conference and training sponsorship
  • Time Off: Generous vacation and unlimited sick days, competitive paid caregiver leaves
  • Hybrid Work Policy: Flexible in-office days with budget for home office setup
The base pay for this role will be between $165,000 and $250,000. This role may also be eligible for other forms of compensation and benefits, such as a discretionary bonus, health, dental and other wellness plans and 401(k) contributions. Discretionary bonus can be a significant portion of total compensation. Actual compensation for successful candidates will be carefully determined based on a number of factors, including their skills, qualifications and experience.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Two Sigma is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

If you believe you need an accommodation, please visit our website for additional information.

We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.


From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve.  Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.


As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high-impact research - designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm.


Take the next step in your career.


The role


Dates: 28th June 2027 - 17th September 2027
Working hours: 09:00 - 17:30


We are looking for exceptional students to join us for a 12-week summer internship within our world-class technology teams.


These functions are central to our engineering efforts. As an intern you will work across a range of platforms that support our quantitative research. You will contribute to the development, enhancement and modernisation of the systems that underpin our business, gaining valuable experience with both legacy and cutting-edge technologies.


This is a hands-on engineering role where you will write production-level code, collaborate with experienced software engineers and contribute to high-impact projects from day one.


Key responsibilities of the role include:


  • Designing and delivering high-quality, maintainable code to work with large and complex datasets
  • Supporting and evolving production platforms and research tools
  • Partnering with quantitative researchers to understand and improve data quality and value
  • Developing and optimising database queries and the underlying infrastructure
  • Enhancing internal tools and data processing pipelines used at scale

As part of your internship, you will receive a structured onboarding experience and be paired with a dedicated mentor. Your mentor will be an experienced engineer who will guide your learning and development.


In addition to on-the-job training, you will gain access to internal technical and professional development courses, alongside opportunities to increase your financial domain knowledge.


Who are we looking for?


We’re seeking sharp, curious and pragmatic software engineers who are eager to work at the intersection of finance and technology.


The ideal candidate will have the following skills and experience:


  • Studying towards a 2:1 or above in Computer Science or a closely related discipline
  • Graduating in 2028 and currently in their penultimate year
  • Experience in at least one object-oriented programming language, such as C#, Java or C++
  • Strong understanding of core computer science concepts, such as algorithms, data structures and systems architecture
  • An interest in how engineering supports quantitative research and complex systems at scale
  • A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving with sound judgement
  • A proactive approach to improving code, systems and ways of working
  • Clear communicate skills across technical and non-technical teams
  • A collaborative mindset with a willingness to share ideas, feedback and knowledge

Why join us?

 

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Lunch provided (via Just Eat for Business) and dedicated barista bar
  • 30 days’ annual leave pro rata
  • 9% company pension contributions
  • Informal dress code and excellent work/life balance
  • Opt-in private health insurance
  • Monthly company events
  • Centrally located office (close to five stations and six tube lines)

  • Familiarity designing and implementing modern observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry)

  • Experience with distributed storage technologies (Lustre, Ceph, S3)

  • Embodies a "system engineer" rather than "system administrator" mindset, thinking systematically and leveraging automation

  • Bachelor degree in computer science

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with HPC frameworks (Slurm, Grid Engine) and Kubernetes-based job orchestrators (Airflow, Kueue, Kubeflow Pipelines), along with other distributed computing frameworks (Ray, Modin, Dask, Spark)

  • Familiarity with hybrid/on-prem environments

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, Singularity), particularly for HPC/batch compute environments

  • Experience with HPC networking (InfiniBand, RDMA)

  • Solid security/IAM foundations (Identity management systems, AWS/GCP IAM, Zero Trust)

  • Partner with PhD researchers to design, implement, and productize machine learning models that drive quantitative trading strategies

  • Develop and maintain complex data pipelines, including data ingestion, feature engineering, validation, and quality monitoring

  • Translate research prototypes and novel ideas into performant, well-tested, production-ready code

  • Build extensible tools and frameworks that accelerate the model development and experimentation lifecycle

  • Supervise, understand, and remediate subtle data quality issues across both research and production environments

  • Proactively lead projects from requirements through delivery, making autonomous decisions about scope, dependencies, and trade-offs, with an emphasis on long-term maintainability

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems design)

  • Demonstrated mathematical maturity — comfort with the concepts and notation used in statistics, linear algebra, optimization, and probability

  • Deep proficiency in Python; experience with R and/or C/C++ is a strong plus

  • Extensive experience with numerical and data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar)

  • Proven experience building or maintaining machine learning systems in a distributed computing environment

  • Proficiency developing in a Linux environment with attention to performance, correctness, and reproducibility

  • Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when working with imperfect or heterogeneous data

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers whose primary expertise is not software engineering

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with experiment management, model evaluation pipelines, or ML workflow orchestration

  • Familiarity with modern ML/AI infrastructure patterns (model serving, feature stores, distributed training)

  • Experience with performance profiling and optimization of numerical or modeling code

  • Prior exposure to financial data, time-series analysis, or quantitative research environments

We are looking for enthusiastic Teaching Assistants with strong backgrounds in mathematics, computer science, or a related quantitative field for our Academy of Math and Programming (AMP) in New York City.

This is a temporary, six-week summer role, including one week of training before the five-week student program. AMP is a residential program serving recent high school graduates of diverse backgrounds who have experienced barriers to access and opportunity within advanced STEM education.

Students study mathematics, computer programming, data analysis, and game theory through challenging and interactive classes, problem-solving sessions, and games. You will work alongside instructors and other teaching assistants to support students in the classroom and help supervise the residential program.

Teaching Assistants support both the mathematics and computer science curricula. We do not expect everyone to have equal depth across every topic. It’s fine if you have greater experience in one subject, as long as you are excited to support both subjects and learn alongside the instructional team.

Additional responsibilities will include:

  • Helping instructors deliver lessons in areas such as combinatorics, number theory, algorithms, programming, and software development
  • Working with students individually and in small groups during classes, problem-solving sessions, and study hours
  • Supporting classroom supervision, assignment review, and other academic coordination
  • Teaching, guiding, and playing strategy games with students
  • Residing with students in the dormitory for the duration of the program and serving as an active, responsible program leader beyond the classroom, supporting student well-being and reinforcing community expectations 
  • Leading academic and social activities during evenings and select weekends

Jane Street deeply values the quality of our educational programming, and we compensate our high-caliber staff accordingly. Travel, housing, and on-site meals will be provided.

About You

  • An undergraduate student in mathematics, computer science, or a related field
  • Experienced with, or interested in, working with students in an academic or residential setting
  • Have a strong background in mathematics, computer science, or both; it is fine to have greater depth in one subject than the other
  • Comfortable with foundational programming and mathematical problem-solving, and willing to learn beyond your primary area of expertise
  • A patient and encouraging communicator who enjoys helping students work through challenging material
  • Exercises sound judgment, maintains clear boundaries, and handles sensitive student matters discreetly, escalating concerns when appropriate
  • Having a genuine interest in strategy, logic, and mathematical games is preferred
  • Available to live on site for the full program and support evening and select weekend activities

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Payroll Specialist to take ownership of the accurate, timely and fully compliant delivery of payroll in India, and to act as a second pair of hands across our Asia-Pacific and Middle East payrolls. Reporting to the UK-based Head of Payroll and working day to day alongside the Senior Payroll Specialist in the UK, you will be the resident subject-matter expert on Indian payroll legislation and statutory obligations within a global, follow-the-sun payroll team.


India payroll is delivered through a managed-service provider. Your role is not to key transactions into a system: it is to own the inputs, interrogate the outputs, hold the vendor to account, evidence the controls and stand behind every number that reaches employees, the regulator and the general ledger. This is a regulated financial services environment where confidentiality, accuracy and a demonstrable audit trail are non-negotiable.


Key responsibilities

India payroll delivery

  • Own the end-to-end monthly India payroll cycle — calendar, cut-offs, inputs, validation, approval, funding, disbursement and post-payroll reconciliation.
  • Prepare, validate and submit payroll inputs covering new hires, leavers, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, variable pay, bonuses, allowances, reimbursements, loans, advances and recoveries.
  • Review the vendor’s gross-to-net output in detail; investigate and resolve every variance against prior period before sign-off, rather than relying on vendor assurance.
  • Manage full and final settlements for leavers, including notice pay, leave encashment, gratuity, recovery of advances and correct tax treatment.
  • Own the annual cycle: investment declarations and proof verification, Form 16 issuance, Form 24Q filings, perquisite valuation, and the transition between the old and new tax regimes.
  • Maintain the payroll calendar and ensure all statutory and internal deadlines are met without exception.

India statutory compliance

  • You will be expected to operate independently on all of the following, and to be the person the wider team turns to when a question of Indian payroll law arises:
  • Provident Fund (EPF/EPS/EDLI): contribution calculation, wage-ceiling application, international worker rules, UAN management, monthly ECR filing,
  • National Pension System (NPS): corporate NPS administration, employer and employee contribution handling, PRAN management and the associated tax deductions and exemptions.
  • Income tax and state-level taxes: TDS computation and deposit, quarterly eTDS returns, Labour Welfare Fund, and state-specific obligations across every state in which the entity employs staff.
  • Professional Tax: registration, slab application and remittance across multiple states, with awareness that rates, slabs and due dates differ by state and change frequently.
  • ESI and Gratuity: eligibility assessment, contribution and accrual, and coordination with Finance on provisioning.
  • Labour Codes: tracking the phased implementation of the four Labour Codes and associated central and state rules, modelling the impact of the wage-definition changes on statutory costs, and preparing the payroll for each change.

Sickness, maternity and absence

  • Administer maternity benefit in line with the Maternity Benefit Act — eligibility, 26-week paid entitlement, adoption and commissioning-mother provisions, ESI interaction and correct payroll treatment throughout the leave period.
  • Administer paternity, sickness, casual, earned and other statutory and company leave, including accrual, carry-forward, encashment and unpaid-leave recoveries.
  • Process sickness absence and long-term absence cases, including any ESI cash-benefit interaction, and ensure returns to work are reflected accurately and promptly in pay.
  • Act as a sensitive and discreet point of contact for employees on leave-related pay queries, working closely with HR Business Partners on complex or confidential cases.

 

Regional support — Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and the UAE

  • Provide preparation, checking and review support for the Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and UAE payrolls, working to the standards set by the Head of Payroll and the UK Senior Payroll Specialist.
  • Build working knowledge of the local statutory frameworks in Singapore;  Hong Kong; Japan; and in the UAE.
  • Provide holiday, peak-period and absence cover for regional payrolls, offering genuine resilience rather than nominal back-up.
  • Support in-country vendors and advisers with input preparation, query resolution and validation of statutory outputs.

 

Vendor, controls and governance

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship with the India payroll provider: service levels, issue escalation, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Operate and evidence the payroll control framework — maker-checker, reconciliations, approval thresholds, segregation of duties and change control — to a standard that withstands internal audit and regulatory scrutiny.
  • Reconcile payroll to the general ledger; prepare journals, accruals and funding requests, and resolve differences with Finance.
  • Support internal and external audit, statutory audit and regulatory requests with complete, well-organised evidence.
  • Handle all employee and payroll data in strict accordance with data protection obligations and internal confidentiality policy.



Stakeholders, reporting and improvement

  • Resolve employee payroll queries professionally and within agreed service levels, escalating judgement calls appropriately.
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Reward, Tax and Mobility on compensation changes, cross-border assignments, equity and deferred-compensation payments.
  • Produce payroll reporting, cost analysis and statutory returns for management and for the business.
  • Identify and deliver process improvements, automation and stronger controls; support payroll system implementations, vendor transitions and entity or country onboarding.
  • Maintain accurate, current desktop procedures and process documentation for every payroll you touch.

Skills and personal attributes

  • Accuracy and ownership. You treat a payroll error as a serious matter, check your own work before anyone else has to, and are accountable for what you sign off.
  • Discretion. You handle salary, bonus and personal circumstances data with complete professionalism.
  • Deadline discipline. Payroll dates do not move; you plan backwards from them and flag risk early.
  • Investigative mindset. You are not satisfied by a number that looks approximately right — you find out why it changed.
  • Clear communication. You can explain a statutory deduction plainly to an employee and technically to an auditor.
  • Remote collaboration. You work effectively across time zones with a small, senior, UK-based team and manage your own workload without close supervision.
  • Adaptability. Indian payroll legislation is in a period of significant change; you keep current and act on it.

 

Additional information

This role sits within a small global payroll team and offers exposure to payroll across Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and the UK. Some flexibility will be required around payroll cut-off dates and to accommodate overlap with the UK working day.



Work Experience/ Background:

Essential

  • A minimum of 5 years’ hands-on experience running end-to-end payroll in India, including full ownership of at least one monthly cycle from inputs to reconciliation.
  • Strong, current and demonstrable knowledge of Indian payroll legislation: Provident Fund, NPS, income tax and TDS, Professional Tax and state-level taxes, ESI, gratuity, bonus and Labour Welfare Fund.
  • Practical experience administering Professional Tax and other state-level obligations across multiple Indian states.
  • Proven experience of sickness, maternity and statutory leave administration and its payroll treatment.
  • Experience working with an outsourced payroll provider — reviewing and challenging vendor output rather than accepting it.
  • Confident, accurate gross-to-net and variance analysis; the ability to explain any individual payslip line by line.
  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivots, large-volume reconciliation) and familiarity with payroll and HR systems such as Workday
  • Experience operating within a documented control environment with audit evidence requirements.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with UK-based colleagues and senior stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Working knowledge of payroll and statutory requirements in one or more of Singapore (CPF, IR8A/IR21), Hong Kong (MPF, IR56 series), Japan (social insurance, resident tax, year-end adjustment) and the UAE (WPS, end-of-service gratuity, GPSSA).
  • Prior experience in financial services, professional services or another regulated, confidentiality-sensitive environment.
  • Experience supporting expatriate and internationally mobile populations, shadow payroll, tax equalisation or hypothetical tax.
  • Experience with equity, carried interest, deferred compensation or bonus-heavy pay structures.
  • Involvement in payroll implementations, vendor transitions or process automation projects.
  • Professional qualification or part-qualification in accounting, HR or payroll (for example CIPP, CA Inter, CMA, MBA (HR)), or an equivalent Indian payroll certification.

If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you.

At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals. Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing.

Overview & Responsibilities

You will work directly with senior professionals to provide immediate impact on a range of projects:

This is a highly selective, 10-week internship with Brevan Howard Macro Ventures (BHMV), the world's first macro venture fund – a new investment category uniting macroeconomic and geostrategic analysis with deep-technology investing. We back companies where scientific breakthrough meets national consequence – in energy, artificial intelligence, space, quantum computing and agricultural technology. The thesis is direct. Technology has become the primary axis of geopolitical competition, and the defining companies of this era will be those positioned along the great macro currents: the energy transition, compute sovereignty, orbital infrastructure, defense and food security, to name a few.


Identifying them requires technical depth and macro judgement in equal measure: we begin with structural shifts – where policy, demand, capital and strategic necessity converge – and then work from the bottom up, testing the science, the engineering and the business. Neither a compelling macro narrative nor an elegant laboratory result is sufficient on its own.


Team members have been involved in ventures that redefined access to orbit, the path to fusion power and global compute. Our ambition is to finance the technologies on which the next chapter of civilization depends, and to identify them before their significance becomes consensus.


That work demands two qualities that rarely coincide: the rigor to be right and the imagination to be early. Large language models have made analysis abundant and imagination decisive – provided it is matched by the discipline to test, verify and revise.


An exceptional transcript should be the starting point, not the most interesting thing about you. We are interested in the question you could not leave alone, the model you built to test it, the connection you made that your discipline did not teach you to see. A genuine interest in investing and the commercial consequences of scientific progress is essential.


You will join the investment team in New York, working directly with BHMV's partners and Founding Chief Scientist on live situations: interrogating technical claims, mapping industries, assessing startups, analyzing financials and identifying investment prospects. The questions extend beyond whether a technology works. What does it cost at scale? What bottleneck does it remove or create? Why is now the right moment? Who ultimately captures the value? You will be expected to connect technical evidence to an investment judgement, not simply describe a technology.


The program opens with Brevan Howard's one-week training in financial markets and programming: at BHMV, the macro half of the job is not optional. On-the-job training in venture capital follows, with a mentor program, talks, and interaction with the founders, scientists and macro investors who shape these fields.


The internship is a two-way process: we are assessing you, and you should be assessing us. Its purpose is to find the people we will hire, by converting top-performing interns to our 2028 Graduate Program.

Qualifications & Requirements

A penultimate-year undergraduate or first-year master's student completed and awarded before July 2028.
Studying for a bachelor's or master's in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics or another technical discipline.
Evidence of original thought – a project, paper, prototype, company or argument that did not exist until you made it.
The depth to take a technical claim apart from first principles, and the judgment to decide whether it matters. 
Prior experience through research, independent projects, startups or internships; finance experience is welcome but not required.
Fluency in programming and financial modeling, including Excel, and the judgment to use AI tools critically.
The self-direction to own a question end to end in a small team, and the humility to be corrected and held to the highest standard.
Precision, discretion and professionalism: our work touches companies of national consequence and is treated accordingly.
An entrepreneurial spirit. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

This is a unique opportunity to gain insight into one of the world’s leading firms operating at the forefront of macro trading. At Brevan Howard, we believe the future of investing lies at the intersection of deep domain expertise and cutting-edge technology. As our industry is being reshaped by AI and automation, you’ll see firsthand how LLMs, retrieval, and agent-like systems are being used in the front-office environment at one of the world’s premier macro hedge funds – where correctness, robustness and speed matter.

About this role

Company Description

HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.[i] Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).

The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.[ii] This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally,[iii] offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. About this role

Aladdin Strategic Relationship Manager, Vice President — Aladdin Client Engagement

Aladdin® is BlackRock's enterprise investment management platform, connecting the information, people, and technology needed to manage money in real time. The platform combines risk analytics with portfolio management, trading, compliance, operations, accounting, and data tools on a single platform to power informed decision-making, effective risk management, efficient trading, and operational scale. Aladdin supports a community of over 200 institutional clients around the world, including some of the largest and most complex investment organizations globally. Aladdin Client Engagement is responsible for maximizing the value of the Aladdin relationship through strategic engagement, product education, and trusted partnership — working closely with clients to be their consultant, problem solver, and business partner.

We are seeking a Vice President to join our Aladdin Client Engagement team as a Strategic Relationship Manager supporting complex institutional clients. This is a client-facing role for someone who can serve as the account quarterback for sophisticated, multi-stakeholder relationships — managing the operating rhythm of client engagement while identifying and driving commercial growth opportunities. The ideal candidate combines strong relationship management instincts with commercial acumen, product curiosity, operational discipline, and comfort using AI and data tools to scale their impact. You will work with clients across the institutional investment landscape whose investment programs span public and private markets, with sophisticated governance structures, broad asset class coverage, and senior stakeholders across investment, operations, risk, technology, and finance. You will partner cross-functionally with product, service, implementation, sales, legal, finance, and business development teams to deliver an integrated, high-quality client experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Own and support day-to-day engagement with senior stakeholders (CIO, COO, CTO, CFO, Heads of Investment, Operations, Risk, and Technology) at complex institutional clients. Develop deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operating model, investment workflows, governance structure, and technology priorities.
  • Commercial Growth: Identify, shape, progress, and help close growth opportunities across the existing client base. Develop and maintain account plans, stakeholder maps, and pipeline views. Support renewal preparation, pricing and commercial discussions, proposal coordination, and internal approval processes. Connect client needs to Aladdin capabilities and translate that into actionable commercial opportunities.
  • Account Operations and Client Orchestration: Serve as the operating backbone of client relationships. Own meeting agendas, follow-ups, action tracking, CRM updates, issue escalation, and stakeholder coordination.   • Commercial mindset with demonstrated experience supporting growth, renewals, client expansion, strategic account planning, or pipeline development

  • Familiarity with buy-side investment management workflows, institutional investment organizations, or enterprise investment technology

  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional, global environment and can operate with limited direction while maintaining high standards

  • Experience with Aladdin, eFront, or other enterprise investment platforms, including investment data platforms, APIs, reporting, analytics, or operating model transformation
  • Experience working with institutional investors, asset managers, asset owners, insurers, official institutions, wealth platforms, asset servicers, or financial technology providers
  • Familiarity with public and private market workflows, including risk, performance, operations, accounting, data management, and reporting
  • Experience using AI tools, workflow automation, prompt engineering, SQL, Excel, Power BI, or other data analysis tools to scale coverage and improve productivity
  • CFA, FRM, CAIA, CIMA, or other relevant investment or technology certifications are helpful but not required

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.

We are seeking a Quantitative Researcher with a strong academic background to a PhD level in a mathematical or science discipline. The role will involve you working closely with other team members to develop models and trading strategies in systematic macro.

What You'll Do:
Quantitative Researchers collect and analyze tens of thousands of data sets, identify patterns and extract insights into the complexities in financial markets. Researchers lean heavily on statistical analysis, machine learning, and data engineering skills; applying the results of their research to forecasts and predictive trading models. Jump’s Quantitative Researchers are constantly collaborating with other scientists, traders, hardware and software developers, and market facing business teams to push for the best expression of our new ideas. You’ll own research projects end to end, in areas such as predictive modeling, alpha research on new datasets, and improving the models and systems behind live trading. Other duties as assigned or needed.

Skills You’ll Need:

Currently pursuing a PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Machine Learning, or any highly quantitative field

Systematic research thinking: the ability to form well-educated hypotheses, design rigorous tests, and draw statistically sound, generalizable conclusions. No matter your area, these are the fundamental aspects of a good researcher, and it is no different at Jump Trading.

Ownership of your research: the ability to explain the choices you made, the alternatives you considered and rejected, and why your approach won. Every idea demands a premise, and every rejection deserves a reason

Experience conducting an in-depth research project with real-world data

Programming experience in Python, with the ability to read, understand, and debug code, including code you didn't write

Communicative and collaborative working style, sharing results early and often and treating mentors' time as a resource to use, not conserve

Creativity and initiative to explore ideas beyond those suggested to you, with the judgment to bring your team along as you do

Perseverance: successful research is the result of lots of failure and intellectual risk-taking, and a PhD is often proof that you can stay with a hard problem for years without quitting

Fascinated and interested in advancing machine learning within the trading community

Desire to work within a collaborative, team-driven environment

Reliable and predictable availability

Discretionary bonus eligibility

HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care options

Employer Paid Group Term Life and AD&D Insurance

Voluntary Life & AD&D insurance

Paid vacation plus paid holidays

Retirement plan with employer match

Wellness Programs

About Us:
Founded two decades ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people across North America, Europe and Asia. Since becoming an independent proprietary trading firm in 2016, DV Trading has scaled rapidly using its own capital, strategies and risk management to provide liquidity to markets worldwide. DV Group affiliates today include two broker-dealers, a cryptocurrency market maker and a growing investment adviser.
DV Equities is the group's Asia-Pacific equities and futures market-making business, trading cash equities, ETFs, index futures and related products on exchanges across the region.

Overview:
We are looking for a 2027 Quantitative Researcher (Graduate) to join our equities team, where you will take direct ownership of systematic signal generation across multiple time horizons. This role is ideal for recent graduates with a strong quantitative foundation and hands-on experience in either high-frequency orderbook research or longer-term signal generation—whether through academic projects, prior internships, or independent research. You will work side-by-side with our senior researchers and traders to explore market data, develop predictive signals, and build models that directly inform real trading decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Analyze market data to uncover patterns, inefficiencies, and predictive signals across different time horizons
- Build and backtest quantitative models using historical market data in a simulation environment
- Apply statistical and machine learning techniques—with an emphasis on tree-based methods—to enhance signal quality
- Collaborate closely with traders and researchers to translate research insights into robust trading strategies
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of data pipelines for large-scale, high-frequency, and time-series market data
- Iterate on research prototypes based on backtest results and team feedback, with increasing independence
- Monitor live strategy performance and refine models based on real market feedback

Requirements:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or related), with an expected graduation by Summer 2027
- Strong proficiency in Python; experience with SQL, statistical modeling, or C++ is highly preferred
- Strong foundation in math, probability, and statistics
- Genuine interest in financial markets, algorithmic trading, and market microstructure
- Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and perform in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
- Ability to maintain composure and communicate clearly under pressure
- Exceptional problem-solving ability and multitasking skills
- Prior internship experience in trading, quantitative research, or data analysis is a plus

Feature Framework Engineer

The Systematic Platform Execution & Exchange Data (SPEED) Team is at the core of Millennium’s Equities, Quant Strategies, and Shared Services Technology organization, powering the firm’s lowest latency solutions for systematic and high frequency trading. SPEED delivers the live trading and market data platforms used by portfolio managers and risk systems, including Latency Critical Trading (LCT), DMA OMS (Client Direct), DMA market data feeds, packet capture (PCAPs), enterprise market data, and intraday data services across latency tiers from sub100 nanoseconds to millisecond sensitive workflows. By building and operating this execution and data infrastructure, SPEED enables portfolio managers and researchers to compete effectively in the most time-critical markets. 

As a Senior Feature Framework Developer on SPEED, you will design and build the most latency-critical components of our trading system. We are aiming for the best in class here. Additionally, you will work on making the platform more scalable. The system must grow along with data volumes while keeping a small footprint. You will collaborate with systems (Linux, network) engineers, senior software engineers as well as senior quantitative researchers, operate and optimize these systems in production, and have clear opportunities to grow into technical and team leadership as the effort scales. This role offers the chance to work end-to-end mission critical HFT systems in a highly technical environment, directly shaping the performance, reliability, and evolution of platforms that are central to Millennium’s trading edge. 

We are looking for a C++ engineer to design and build high‑performance, low‑latency applications that process large volumes of real‑time data. You will work on systems where nanoseconds and throughput matter, optimizing every layer from algorithms and data structures to networking and OS interaction.
 

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain high‑performance C++ services handling high message rates and low‑latency workloads.

  • Optimize existing components for latency, throughput, and CPU/memory efficiency.

  • Develop and tune networking, messaging, and I/O layers to handle large data volumes reliably.

  • Profile and debug performance issues at application, OS, and network levels.

  • Collaborate with quantitative, trading, and infrastructure teams (or analogous business/tech teams) to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Write clean, production‑quality code with appropriate tests and documentation.

  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20 or later) 5+ years of experience

  • Analytics Focus:

    • KDB / Q Experience for large market data

    • Modern data analysis with pytorch, pandas and modern tooling including Apache arrow

    • Familiar with basics statistics as applied to financial research

  • Proven experience building performance‑critical, real‑time, or low‑latency systems (e.g., networking, trading systems, telemetry, gaming engines, or similar).

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, memory management, and optimization.

  • Experience using profiling, benchmarking, and performance analysis tools (e.g., perf, valgrind, flame graphs, CPU/memory profilers).

  • Proficiency with version control (Git) and standard build systems (CMake, Ninja, etc.).

  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and attention to detail; ability to work in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to navigate large organizations, create cross-team synergies, and influence outcomes.

  • High accountability and ownership; able to self-manage time, set priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with kernel bypass or user‑space networking technologies (e.g., DPDK, RDMA, VMA, Solarflare/OpenOnload) – helpful but not required.

  • Familiar with AI productivity enhancing coding tools

  • Experience in financial markets, market data distribution, order routing, or exchange connectivity.

  • Experience with monitoring/telemetry for high‑performance systems (latency histograms, throughput metrics, SLAs).

  • Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for tooling and automation.

  • AI: Familiar with AI productivity enhancing coding tools.

Personal Attributes

  • Obsessed with performance, measurement, and data‑driven optimization.

  • Comfortable owning features end‑to‑end and operating in a production environment.

  • Clear communicator who can work closely with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

  • Proactive, self‑directed, and able to thrive in a highly iterative environment.

Role Summary

This is a highly visible senior-level individual contributor leadership role where you will influence the strategic direction of Identity and Access Management across a global, highly regulated organization. As a trusted technical leader, you will drive the evolution of our identity ecosystem, transforming legacy, Active Directory-centric architectures into a modern, cloud-first identity platform built on Zero Trust principles. You will lead the design and advancement of next-generation identity capabilities across Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM Identity Center, federation, privileged access management (PAM), conditional access, PKI/certificate services, identity automation, and cloud-native security controls. Working across infrastructure, security, and application teams, you will establish the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for enterprise identity services that secure thousands of users, applications, and critical business systems.

 

In this role, you will serve as a senior technical authority, providing deep expertise, strategic influence, and hands-on guidance without direct people management responsibilities. Partnering closely with security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, operations, and architecture teams, you will define enterprise standards, assess and mitigate risk, guide critical engineering decisions, and mentor technical talent across the organization. Success in this position requires the ability to balance long-term architectural vision with practical execution, ensuring identity capabilities are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and evolving regulatory requirements.

 

Responsibilities

  • Define and advance the enterprise IAM technology strategy, roadmap, standards, and reference patterns for modern identity services across hybrid Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and AWS environments.
  • Lead complex IAM modernization efforts, including migration from legacy AD, ADFS, MIM, LDAP, and directory service patterns to cloud-based authentication, authorization, lifecycle, and access governance models.
  • Serve as an authoritative technical advisor for identity architecture decisions, including federation, conditional access, privileged access, identity protection, cross-tenant access, B2B/B2C identity, entitlement management, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Partner with cloud, infrastructure, security, audit, risk, and application teams to design secure and scalable access models for AWS, Microsoft, SaaS, and enterprise application ecosystems.
  • Drive adoption of Zero Trust, least privilege, adaptive access, JIT access, risk-based authentication, and modern MFA capabilities across enterprise platforms.
  • Establish and maintain IAM standards, design patterns, engineering guardrails, operational procedures, and compliance reporting practices.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex troubleshooting across Kerberos, SPNs, delegation, certificates, federation, conditional access, MFA, SAML assertions, OAuth flows, DNS, and network authentication dependencies.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders through design reviews, troubleshooting sessions, knowledge sharing, and standards-based engineering practices.
  • Assess security risks and technical debt within IAM platforms and define remediation plans that improve resiliency, auditability, and operational effectiveness.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams through clear communication, pragmatic decision-making, and enterprise-level technical judgment.

 

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, operating, or modernizing IAM capabilities in a large enterprise environment.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with hybrid identity architectures spanning Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, federation, privileged access management, and cloud authentication models.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of security controls, access governance, audit requirements, and operational risk management in regulated environments.
  • Proven ability to create standards, influence architecture decisions, and mentor engineering teams.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across identity, directory, certificate, authentication, federation, cloud, DNS, and network dependencies.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience modernizing identity capabilities as part of a broader cloud, data center exit, endpoint modernization, or platform transformation program.
  • Experience integrating identity patterns into AWS-based application and infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience with certificate lifecycle management, PKI modernization, passwordless authentication, and Zero Trust adoption.
  • Experience defining enterprise IAM roadmaps, control frameworks, engineering standards, or capability maturity plans.
  • Relevant Microsoft, AWS, security, or identity-focused certifications are beneficial but not required.

 

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

 

Work Flexibility

This role is eligible for hybrid work, with up to three days per week from home.

The Role

The Quality Engineer, Data Center Operations is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, reliability, quality assurance and continuous improvement across data center operations.

The role establishes and maintains effective quality-management practices, monitors operational performance, supports the transition of new infrastructure into live operations, drives corrective actions and lessons learned, and supports compliance with applicable national and European Union legislation, regulations and standards.

Working closely with data center operations, engineering, environmental, health and safety, security, sustainability, legal, and management teams, the Quality Engineer ensures that operational processes are consistently documented, measured, controlled, challenged and improved.

Operational Quality Management

  • Develop, implement, and maintain an effective and proportionate quality-management framework for data center operations.
  • Ensure that operational procedures, including MOPs, SOPs and EOPs, work instructions, control measures, and technical documentation are accurate, consistent, and up to date.
  • Monitor compliance with approved operational processes, service requirements, quality standards, and internal policies.
  • Conduct regular operational quality reviews, inspections, process assessments, and internal audits.
  • Identify quality-related risks, process gaps, recurring incidents and alarms, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support operational readiness activities, including commissioning, handover and transition of new or expanded data center infrastructure into live operations.
  • Monitor supply-chain partners and on-site contractors to ensure adherence to quality benchmarks and agreed operational standards.
  • Review the quality and effectiveness of maintenance activities and operational change-management processes.

Regulatory Compliance and Reporting

  • Work with Legal and other relevant functions to understand applicable national and European Union regulatory requirements affecting data center operations.
  • Translate applicable regulatory requirements into practical operational controls, procedures, reporting processes, and evidence requirements in conjunction with the relevant functional owners.
  • Coordinate and assure the quality, completeness and timely provision of data required for statutory, regulatory, sustainability, environmental, energy-efficiency, and operational reporting, with accountability for individual submissions remaining with the relevant functional owner.
  • Maintain a structured register of applicable regulations, reporting obligations, responsible owners, deadlines, and supporting evidence.
  • Ensure that operational reporting and supporting data are accurate, complete, traceable, and provided within the required timeframes.

Performance Monitoring and Data Quality

  • Define, collect, validate, and filter operational data from multiple data center systems and sources.
  • Define, maintain, and develop operational quality metrics, key performance indicators, and reporting dashboards.
  • Coordinate reporting tools implementation projects.
  • Monitor operational performance in areas such as availability, reliability, incidents, maintenance, alarms, energy efficiency, environmental performance, capacity, service quality, and corrective actions.
  • Prepare regular quality and operational-performance reports for site management and other stakeholders.
  • Provide management with clear analysis, findings, risks, and recommendations based on operational data and performance trends.

Incident Management and Corrective Actions

  • Support the investigation of operational incidents, quality deviations, process failures, and non-conformities.
  • Facilitate or participate in root-cause analyses using appropriate quality and problem-solving methods.
  • Coordinate corrective and preventive actions and ensure that agreed actions are assigned, documented, implemented, and verified.
  • Monitor recurring incidents and alarms and systemic issues to identify opportunities for long-term improvement.
  • Maintain records of incidents, audit findings, non-conformities, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
  • Support the effective communication and implementation of lessons learned across relevant operational teams and other XTX data centers.

Continuous Improvement

  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, accountability, standardisation, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead or support improvement initiatives that increase operational reliability, efficiency, compliance, safety, and service quality.
  • Use operational data, audits, incidents, and stakeholder feedback to prioritise improvement activities.
  • Share best practices and help embed improved processes into day-to-day operations and standardise effective practices across XTX data centers.
  • Proactively challenge existing processes and ways of working where data, incidents or operational experience indicate that a safer, more reliable or more efficient approach is available.

Documentation and Change Control

  • Maintain effective document-control and records-management practices for operational documentation.
  • Review procedures, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, reports, risk assessments, operating instructions, and quality records.
  • Ensure that documents have clear ownership, approval, version control, review dates, and retention requirements.
  • Participate in operational change-management processes and assess the quality, compliance, reporting, reliability, operational risk and documentation impacts of proposed changes.
  • Verify that operational changes are appropriately assessed, approved, communicated, implemented, tested where appropriate, and documented.

Role Objective

The objective of the role is to provide management and operational teams with reliable assurance that data center operations are controlled, compliant, measurable, reliable and continuously improving.

The Quality Engineer helps ensure that the organization can demonstrate operational excellence through accurate data, effective processes, robust documentation, timely reporting, and verifiable evidence.

The role is expected to actively identify weaknesses and improvement opportunities, challenge existing practices where appropriate, and use operational data, incidents and lessons learned to drive measurable improvements in reliability and operational performance across XTX's data centers.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, quality management, industrial management, information technology, energy, environmental management, or another relevant field.
  • Relevant professional experience in quality engineering, operational excellence, compliance, technical reporting, or continuous improvement within a mission-critical or highly regulated operational environment.
  • Experience in data centers, critical infrastructure, energy, telecommunications, utilities, industrial facilities, or another highly regulated operational environment is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in operational performance measurement, internal auditing, incident/root-cause investigation and corrective-action management.
  • Experience with quality-management systems and recognised management-system standards is an advantage.
  • Understanding of critical infrastructure operations, operational risk, business continuity, energy efficiency, environmental performance, and information security is beneficial.
  • Experience working with operational data, reporting tools, dashboards, maintenance-management systems, or document-management systems is preferred.
  • Proficient in English and at least B1 (intermediate) level in Finnish.

About the role

As a Macro Analyst at IMC in Amsterdam, you will build the quantitative tools and analysis behind the team’s macro research. Your work will focus on Python, data, maintaining the scenario record and backtesting research ideas, helping translate macro-event scenarios into inputs for the European equity index volatility curve.

Working closely with traders, senior analysts and the Lead Macro Analyst, you will connect your analysis to the desk’s exposure and evaluate your calls against market outcomes. Alongside building and testing, you will contribute to event coverage during European trading hours and relevant out-of-hours futures sessions.

As you demonstrate an edge through your work, there is scope to develop into position taking and longer-horizon research.

Your Core Responsibilities

  • Build and own Python tools and data workflows for macro research, scenario analysis and backtesting;
  • Maintain a structured record of event scenarios, their underlying assumptions and subsequent outcomes, making the research available for testing and review;
  • Backtest research ideas, signals and models, using statistical analysis to assess their performance and identify areas for improvement;
  • Develop and update quantitative analysis for macro-event scenarios, working with traders and senior analysts to translate the results into inputs for the volatility curve;
  • Understand the desk’s exposure to the events you cover, including whether it is long or short an event, and use that context when discussing the implications of your analysis;
  • Score your own calls against actual outcomes and use the findings to improve the tools, models and scenario analysis you contribute.

Your Skills and Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in quantitative research or a trading-focused analytical role, ideally within a macro hedge fund pod or at a competing trading firm;
  • Hands-on Python skills, with experience preparing and analyzing data and applying statistics to research questions;
  • Experience building analytical tools and backtesting research ideas; having built signals or models used in live trading is an advantage;
  • Good understanding of macroeconomic drivers and equity index markets, including familiarity with options and volatility;
  • A disciplined approach to recording assumptions and evaluating results, with the ability to connect your analysis to trading exposure and refine your views through evidence and feedback.

Company Description


HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.


HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.[i] Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).


The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.[ii] This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally,[iii] offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. About this role

Aladdin Data platforms and services are designed to deliver industry leading investment data and risk analytics content to the Aladdin community, including BlackRock as the largest client.  The primary users include investors, risk managers, compliance officials, investment operations and technology teams for broader organization applications.  We are proud to supply the data products and solutions to meet the evolving needs of portfolio management, risk and performance analysis, investment compliance, regulatory reporting, client reporting and beyond. 

 

Our Data Implementations team of data implementation specialists covers end-to-end Aladdin data flows from vendor and client input data sets to security, portfolio, benchmark, and financial analytics output data for new and expanding Aladdin clients. The team works directly with clients and Aladdin Client Transformation specialists to understand client dependencies, business objectives and custom use cases to ensure Aladdin’s data and analytics are effectively enhanced, deployed, and adopted across each function and organization. The team also leads the configuration of Aladdin Risk and Analytics environments, critical client file loaders and risk and performance benchmark configuration. 

 

Our clients cover global, multi-asset managers or owners allocating across fixed income, equity, private markets, and derivatives.  The team provides the data specialties across asset classes and data domains for the successful whole-portfolio modelling. Successful Aladdin data implementation specialists develop and excel in many cross-functional skills including client communication, project management, business analysis as well as hands-on data analysis and technology system configuration. Innovation is at the core of Aladdin’s culture, and the team is continuously solutioning for our clients and re-engineering our processes.  

 

At the forefront of evolving market and industry data needs, with each successful projects, we drive continuous developments and transformation initiatives to expand our solutions and advance our data products capabilities.   

 

Role Description:  

 

This role is a hybrid hands-on implementation and AI transformation position. The team is looking for a senior leader within the team to help manage our growing volume of new clients, including leading several data implementation specialists in the performance of their responsibilities. The successful candidate will directly be responsible for multiple projects, across all data domains and capabilities.  In parallel, they will be redesigning how implementations are executed using Agentic AI and LLM-enabled workflows. This role blends execution  

credibility, systems thinking, and measurable change delivery. 

 

 

Key Responsibilities:  

 

Hands-On Implementation Delivery 

  • Deliver end-to-end client implementation projects, including requirements analysis, data onboarding, configuration, validation, and reconciliation. 
  • Operate existing tools, playbooks, and controls firsthand to understand delivery constraints and risks. 
  • Build credibility with clients and delivery teams through direct ownership of outcomes. 

 

AI-Driven Implementation Transformation 

  • Identify manual, repetitive, or high-friction activities across the implementation lifecycle. 
  • Design, prototype, and apply Agentic AI and LLM-driven workflows to reduce effort, cycle time, and rework. 
  • Focus on direct execution, solution building, and rapid adoption within active delivery teams. 
  • Partner with transformation and engineering teams to industrialize successful AI patterns into the standard operating model. 

 

Productivity, Scale, and Adoption 

  • Establish baseline delivery metrics and track improvements enabled by AI (e.g., cycle time, throughput, error reduction). 
  • Drive measurable productivity outcomes with a target of achieving step-change (2×) efficiency while maintaining quality and control. 
  • Enable adoption through documentation, demonstrations, coaching, and influence. 

 

Qualifications and skillsets: 

 

We are looking for quick learners, independent thinkers with new perspectives to challenge the way we operate and help prototype new solutions we can ultimately deploy to a standard implementation playbook. Individuals with strong technical and analytical interests would find leading and transforming the Aladdin Data Implementation practice incredibly challenging and rewarding in supporting their career development.  

 

Requirements:  

 

  • A Bachelor’s Degree is required, with preference to computer science or engineering majors. 
  • 8+ years of experience either as an investment/data technology implementation specialist or with direct relevant user, development, service, or operation experiences. 
  • Familiarity with investment data and analytics is required; Private markets or derivative specialities is a plus. 
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying Agentic AI or LLM-based tools to automate or augment business processes, or equivalent formal training. 
  • Track record of initiating projects that enhance business workflow and improve client experiences. 
  • Strong track record of successfully handling and completing large and complex projects. Critical thinking and demonstratable experience using technology to solve problems at scale. 
  • Shown ability to work well independently or as part of a team in an innovative, ambitious, and fast-paced environment, run multiple tasks, adapt to change, and work well under tight time restraints. 
  • Comfortable working with clients and partners at all levels of the business including leading senior Steercos. 
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills. 
  • Experience with Python and SQL preferred

Fundamental Equities (FE) sits within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group (PMG). The business provides a global investment platform offering BlackRock clients a comprehensive range of actively managed, high conviction equity strategies.  

  

FE’s global hybrid research model emphasizes the strength of an independent team approach with the benefits of platform-wide collaboration and connectivity. Company-level engagement and rigorous research underpin our investment teams’ deep domain expertise and lead to high conviction portfolios that aim to generate alpha for our clients.  

  

Fundamental Equity Core Portfolio Manager, APAC  

This is an Associate Core Portfolio Manager role within BlackRock’s Fundamental Equity business. Based in Taipei, the role will primarily provide regional Core PM support across FE APAC, including Taiwan, Japan, Australia and Hong Kong. The role combines daily, market-sensitive portfolio implementation and control responsibilities with broader regional projects. A secondary, but material, focus will be the development of technology-enabled solutions for the Core PM platform, requiring strong technical capability, proficiency in Python and the practical application of AI tools to improve investment workflows.
